protocol.command_projection: Node addresses and executable paths are variables; other recorded arguments are retained.
protocol.log_projection: Numeric tokens are retained; INFO-interleaved rows are reassembled; host identities are removed.
protocol.host_binary: HPC-image bundled all_reduce_perf; not rebuilt for the host arm.
protocol.driver_boundary: ROCm version strings report the software stack; the host amdgpu module version was not independently captured.
protocol.scope: Communication microbenchmark, not a model-serving or long-term reliability test.

runs.command:
mpirun -np 16 -H ${NODE_A}:8,${NODE_B}:8 \
  -map-by ppr:8:node --bind-to numa \
  -x NCCL_IB_HCA=^mlx5_8:1,mlx5_an0:1 \
  -x NCCL_IB_PCI_RELAXED_ORDERING=1 \
  -x NCCL_DEBUG=VERSION \
  --mca pml ucx --mca btl '^vader,tcp,openib,uct' \
  -x PATH -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH \
  "${RCCL_BIN}" -g 1 -f 2 -b 1G -e 16G -c 0 -n 50 -w 20 < /dev/null

boundary.en: Different ROCm/RCCL and test builds; not an isolated container-overhead experiment.
boundary.cn: ROCm、RCCL 和测试程序构建不同，不能把差异单独归因于容器开销。

runs.command:
mpirun --allow-run-as-root -np 16 -H ${NODE_A}:8,${NODE_B}:8 \
  -map-by ppr:8:node --bind-to numa \
  -x NCCL_IB_HCA=^mlx5_8:1,mlx5_an0:1 \
  -x NCCL_IB_PCI_RELAXED_ORDERING=1 \
  -x NCCL_DEBUG=VERSION \
  --mca pml ucx --mca btl '^vader,tcp,openib,uct' \
  --mca plm_rsh_args "-p 2222" \
  -x PATH -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH \
  "${RCCL_BIN}" -g 1 -f 2 -b 1G -e 16G -c 0 -n 50 -w 20

boundary.en: One completed sweep; image-default NCCL_MIN_NCHANNELS reached local ranks only.
boundary.cn: 仅一次完成的扫描；镜像默认 NCCL_MIN_NCHANNELS 只传到了本地进程。

runs.command:

boundary.en: The data check and INFO logging come from a separate run, not the headline performance run.

label.cn: 不映射 IB 设备：退回 Socket

runs.command:
env -u NCCL_MIN_NCHANNELS mpirun --allow-run-as-root -np 16 -H ${NODE_A}:8,${NODE_B}:8 \
  -map-by ppr:8:node --bind-to numa \
  -x NCCL_IB_HCA=^mlx5_8:1,mlx5_an0:1 \
  -x NCCL_IB_PCI_RELAXED_ORDERING=1 \
  -x NCCL_DEBUG=INFO -x NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=INIT,NET --mca btl_tcp_if_include eth0 \
  --mca pml ob1 --mca btl 'self,vader,tcp' \
  --mca plm_rsh_args "-p 2222" \
  -x PATH -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH \
  "${RCCL_BIN}" -g 1 -f 2 -b 1G -e 1G -c 1 -n 5 -w 2

boundary.en: MPI used TCP in both arms; one message size, not the full headline sweep.
boundary.cn: 两组 MPI 都走 TCP；只测一个消息大小，不是主结果的完整扫描。
